rationale: Approve a prospective amendment to the bounded offline urh-03 method. Exact compiled dispatcher and selector execution in U-Boot sandbox, followed by QEMU virt boot of the hash-matched FIT-extracted kernel and initrd through the actual one-shot controller, can establish the offline handoff behavior. QEMU must write and read back the full synthetic image, then boot normal A from that resulting target with artifact continuity demonstrated. This does not establish physical H616 U-Boot-to-FIT execution; that remains mandatory for urh-04. The submitted evidence does not yet pass: the verifier found an external QEMU boot, a separate normal-slot snapshot, unexecuted retry tests, incomplete fault-path boot evidence, and Beelink logs it could not inspect.
evidence_required: Reproducible sandbox traces for the exact dispatcher and selector on staged media, including marker and FIT integrity, armed selection, and unarmed or corrupted fallback.
Hashes binding the staged FIT members to those booted in QEMU; actual controller execution, full write, flush, independent readback, GPT checks, and a normal A boot tied to the written target.

Executed refusal and interruption cases, including after-bulk and after-first-env retries, showing marker consumption and no automatic target reopen; urh-02 stage faults must demonstrate boot fallback.
Independently inspectable result files and serial logs, plus staging-space and boot-memory measurements.
recording: Add a dated, prospective urh-03 acceptance amendment and obtain a new scope-bound approval before resubmission and independent verification. Preserve the original decision, failed verification, and completed urh-01 evidence at their original commits; do not rewrite urh-01 or reuse its passing verification for revised criteria. Keep urh-04 and urh-05 as separate hardware gates.
